name: ai-visit-website
description: Discover article candidates, run authorized Chrome reading batches, save reviewed Markdown, and search a local archive.

interface.longDescription: Discover article candidates, convert public or user-authorized Chrome pages to clean Markdown, run bounded reading batches, explicitly archive reviewed content with SHA-256 deduplication, and search saved evidence locally.
defaultPrompt: Discover this public website and identify the pages relevant to my goal.
Read this page as clean Markdown and show me the source metadata.
Use my paired Chrome session to read this authorized article.
Batch-read selected article URLs and report progress before I review them.
Search my saved website archive for evidence about this topic.
